contracts: Four color and six emoji workspace presets instantiate RustActionView plain View hosts without Button/ButtonController instances. Appearance row items and selection projection use common action accessors. Native comparison retains GlyphButton.

The shared glyph action host accepts a native-focus-ring option, defaulting to the existing enabled policy for other families. Appearance disables native FocusRing children and retains focus drawing in its shared scene, matching its prior policy. The same shared glyph scene/native fallback consumes explicit swatch color and emoji label presentation data.

Appearance scheduling and form viewport callbacks synchronously retire input on clipped presets before GPU coalescing. Existing workspace-change, create-form/hide and window/capture cancellation remains. Rust state/input policy and existing browser/domain/persistence commands are unchanged.

The new shared case checks actual host types, roles/names, empty Rust control children, AX/disabled admission, physical settings-window Space, selected color/emoji store values and actual fallback swatch pixels. Rust-specific branches check scroll-out-and-immediate-back, widget hide/show and workspace retarget late release.
The shared glyph host now preserves Button tooltip-to-AX-name updates while retaining custom names. The footer regression checks the accessible pin label after pin, unpin and repin.

Existing appearance scene/geometry/input/editor-composition/workspace-change, appearance persistence, form viewport and header/footer/split/row action regressions retain their assertions. No dependency, native browser admission/store or persistence policy change.

previous_full_checkpoint.scope: The previous full checkpoint predates this preset host migration. This source has targeted acceptance only.

remaining: Other Button control families, native per-control View identity, stable Rust nodes, containers/placement and UI coordination remain open.
Manual hardware trackpad, IME candidates, VoiceOver, global RTL, scale/theme and GPU recovery remain open.
Current-main combined network policy and final shipped dependency/license/notice acceptance remain outside this frozen UI lab.
gpu_log_diagnostics_note: Raw nonfatal compositor diagnostic counts remain unresolved and do not establish performance gains.

initial_probe.note: The initial preset-host probe passed 5 Metal / 4 Views, including fallback color pixels. Final source additionally restores the shared glyph tooltip-to-AX-name policy and adds pin/unpin/repin accessible-name assertions; focus and affected gates were rerun against that final binary.
